title: Week 11: 81.5 Points of Pain: pjh5473 Flattens Cwmessi
summary: pjh5473 posts the week's high score and beats Cwmessi by 81.5, while three managers lose games their own benches would have won. Plus rookie risers, two trades from a busy aaronyuhas, the bubble race, and Djax818 putting a nine-game streak on the line against pjh5473.
